verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents its own automated, "secured data room" that collects completed documents and smart-links them to the cap table, so the diligence-ready core of the story is covered. The evidence never shows sharing that room with outside counsel or investors, or setting per-party permissions. missing for 10: documented external sharing with counsel/investors, granular access permissions/roles, cap-table views exposed to external viewers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors

citations.quote: your cap table and all the documents in your data room are tied together using a smart-linking feature
your automatic Data Room works behind-the-scenes to add important documents as they are completed
every time you make a change, the resulting docs are automatically collected and organized
the award agreement will be tied to the corresponding board consent, subsequent exercise actions, stock certificates, and other future related documentation
